parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule action to modify.

This is the rule action ID returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html to create a rule action. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html to view the rule action ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的规则动作ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69586.html创建规则动作成功后，返回的规则动作ID，您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69517.html，从返回结果中查看对应的规则动作ID
parameters.name: action_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule action. Valid values:

<props="china">- **DATAHUB**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.</props>
<props="china">- **ONS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for MSMQ distribution.</props>
- **MNS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
- **REPUBLISH**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to another IoT Platform topic.
- **AMQP**: forwards data to an AMQP consumer group.
- **OTS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

> - Rules whose data format is binary (the **DataType** parameter of the rule is set to **BINARY**) do not support forwarding data to Tablestore.
- The cloud products to which the rules engine DPI engine can forward data vary by region. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85669.html that are active for the rules engine
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作类型，取值：

<props="china">- **DATAHUB**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。</props>
<props="china">- **ONS**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。</props>
- **MNS**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
- **FC**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
- **REPUBLISH**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至另一个物联网平台 Topic。
- **AMQP**：数据流转到AMQP消费组。
- **OTS**：流转规则处理后的Topic数据至阿里云表格存储，进行NoSQL数据存储。

> - 数据格式为二进制的规则（即规则的**DataType**参数是**BINARY**）不支持转发数据至OTS（表格存储）。
- 服务地域不同，规则引擎所支持的数据转发目标云产品不同。具体请参见规则引擎相关https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85669.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the rule action. The required configurations vary based on the rule action type.
